description: Positionnement dans la rame is a dataset listed in Île-de-France Mobilités open data, an open data portal of a public transport authority, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Ce jeu de données contient les données de position dans les rames de métros,afin de savoir à quel endroit se positionner pour atteindre plus facilement sa sortie ou correspondance. Les données sont fournies par la RATP et sont utilisées sur l'application et le site Île-de-France Mobilité. Coverage: France (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Arrêts. Its keywords are RATP, Chercheur ou journaliste, Plateforme numérique. The portal shows 2025-02-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-idfm-open-data-portal.
